summary: perf(settings): lazy-load scoped-keys in the OAuth finish hook
description:
Because:

- The scoped-keys prefetch checked keysJwk, but key construction is gated on wantsKeys(), so a request with keysJwk and a scope without scoped keys loaded the crypto chunk for no use.

This commit:

- Gates the prefetch in useFinishOAuthFlowHandler on wantsKeys().
- Replaces the Sync-without-keysJwk prefetch test with a keysJwk-without-scoped-keys case.

Closes FXA-14854
